en:
Hold on, Shuichi. We can only log out one
person at a time.
...Gonta have next turn.

Um... So Gonta just say name in phone,
and someone come get him?
Who cares? Just do it already.
Um... Gonta Gokuhara...

He disappeared...
So that's what logging out looks like.
So, the avatars disappear when we log out.

But Miu's avatar is still here and
unmoving, right?
...What does that mean?
A-Anyway, let's hurry and go back!
Tsumugi Shirogane...

Oh, Shuichi, you can log out before me. I'm sure
your detective's intuition is kicking in, right?
So, go ahead.
Don't be shy, go ahead.

Oh, so you're actually going first? Ah-haha,
I was kidding! But no, seriously. Go ahead.

Oh, wait! Now that we're alone, I wanna
tell you something.
...What is it?
You're really useful.
Huh?

So, how about you stop hanging out with dumb
ol' Kaito, and be *my* friend instead?
I think I can be useful to you, too...y'know?
I can help you save everyone.
And you wanna save everyone, riiiiight?
...Shuichi Saihara.

Nee-heehee...aw, I got rejected.
But I won't give up that easily.

When I find someone I like, I'd do anything to
get them to notice me...even strangle them.

<CLT=cltMIND>I'm worried about Miu!
I need to log out!
